input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Deepen (flagship 5) einvoice-preflight: HR creator writes the out-of-scope labels (HR:POVNAK, HR:PP, HR:PPMV, HR:N) and document-level allowances/charges

errors.what: First fetch of the authority's samples used guessed raw.githubusercontent file names (404); a sparse clone of the mirror listed the real names (eRacun_ prefix).
First SEF build picked the 1.0.0 HR XSLT from the jar (find | head -1); rebuilt from 1.0.4, the version the plain rules are compiled from.
platform/ci/inherited_keys.py flagged two HR_OUT_OF_SCOPE[label] lookups; fixed with an Object.hasOwn helper.

doc_friction.issue: Names the samples without their eRacun_ prefix (e.g. POVRATNA_NAKNADA_stavka), so raw URLs built from it 404; the real names are eRacun_PDV_NEOP_POVRATNA_NAKNADA_stavka.xml etc.
Header gives the jar path external/schematron/1.0.4/ but the jar holds 1.0.0 to 1.0.4; a find for the file name picks the wrong one silently.
node_modules is not gitignored in the venture; an npm i --no-save for the plain route leaves an untracked tree one 'git add -A' away from a commit. I added it to .git/info/exclude locally.

goal: Deepen a flagship with a hard slice: Croatian out-of-scope amounts and document-level charges, checked against the authority's samples and XSLT
notes: Five Porezna uprava samples rebuilt with the creator: amounts due 130.00/130.00/128.00/14500.00/135.00 match; plain route and authority's 1.0.4 XSLT (Saxon-JS) raise no HR rule; no EN 16931 fatal. 34/34 seeded edits agree between engines. Non-HR: XRechnung/Peppol/EN16931 UBL+CII with a discount and shipping charge, no fatal, read-back totals match. Playwright at 390 px: three examples generate with no findings, no horizontal scroll. run_venture_tests.py einvoice-preflight: ok (16 skipped need build-schematron). run_workflow_locally --for-changes: see PR. Found: authority's HR-BR-29 compares a sequence with = 0 (existential), so tax on one of two O rows passes it; HR-BR-28/54 still catch it.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: an e-invoicing developer reading the HR samples and XSLT, implementing BG-20/21 in two syntaxes plus the HR extension, tests and differential: about 1.5 days

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
